result.rationale: In the zoho-bigin CalendarService diff, `tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` is then accessed as `tokenInfo.data.error` and `tokenInfo.data.access_token`, an axios-shaped response, but in sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch `Response` (which has no `.data`), so `.data` is undefined and the code crashes. Same issue applies to the hubspot/zohocrm axios usages, confirming the mechanism is real and introduced by this diff.

judged_text: In sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response while the surrounding code treats the result as an axios response and reads `tokenInfo.data`, which is undefined on a Response. Bigin token refresh in sharing mode crashes on `tokenInfo.data.error`/`tokenInfo.data.access_token` access (undefined), so Bigin calendar operations fail on every shared deployment.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response while the surrounding code treats the result as an axios response and reads `tokenInfo.data`, which is undefined on a Response. Bigin token refresh in sharing mode crashes on `tokenInfo.data.error`/`tokenInfo.data.access_token` access (undefined), so Bigin calendar operations fail on every shared deployment.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, the function calls `fetch(...)` and returns the raw `Response`. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, token refresh was changed to `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and the subsequent code still treats it like an Axios response (`tokenInfo.data.error`, and later accesses like `tokenInfo.data.access_token`). A Fetch `Response` has no `.data` property, so in sharing mode this will be `undefined` and will throw/crash when dereferenced, breaking Bigin token refresh.
